audit.why: Sivir Q pokes through minions at 1200 range and W Ricochet lets her shove; Smolder has no way to answer pre-stacks, so early/mid favors Sivir and late favors Smolder once Q outranges Boomerang Blade — matches the level chart.
Power spikes are stack thresholds (25/125/225) plus first item; Sivir's spike is level 6 R On the Hunt for team all-ins. Already reflected in spikes[] and phases[].

audit.whatIsWrong: Sivir's E Spell Shield flags terrain: it creates a barrier that blocks paths and dashes, i.e. it can cut off Smolder's retreat lane since he has no dash of his own. The missingInteractions entry (terrain-cuts-retreat) is not mentioned anywhere in the current text.
audit.why: Smolder has zero dashes (his only mobility is the E glide, which ignores terrain but is on a long cooldown). Sivir's Spell Shield wall physically blocking a retreat path is a real risk the page never warns about.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[2].d: Spell Shield's terrain blocks your escape path too — hold Flash for that wall, not chip damage.
